fixes.what: Add `justify-content: end;` or switch `.accordion__body` from `display: grid` to `display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;` so long ceremony descriptions never overflow out the top of the 620px accordion frame on desktop (visible in index-desktop-2.jpg where 'Sofreh Aghd' and its Persian heading are clipped off the top).
fixes.why: A Persian parent or couple seeing 'Sofreh Aghd' cut off at the top of the frame loses the headline of their core ceremony.

fixes.what: Add `<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="traditions" value="Attan"> Attan</label>` and `<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="traditions" value="Milni"> Milni</label>` (or group Baraat / Milni) to the inquiry form checkboxes.
fixes.why: You highlight Attan for Afghan families and Milni for Sikh/Hindu families on weddings.html; seeing them in the inquiry checklist deepens cultural trust.

fixes.what: Explicitly mention coordinating with both the bride's and groom's sides for the Milni exchanges (e.g., 'calling each pair of elders for the milni garlands') and managing shoe-stealing (Joota Chupai) / Vidaai timing.
fixes.why: Parents paying for South Asian weddings stress most about family introductions during Milni and keeping the Vidaai on schedule with the venue.
